title: Approvals
description: GOTCHA has done the work. These are the decisions it can't take on its own.
unavailable: We couldn't read your approvals just now.

queue.label: Waiting for a decision
queue.waiting: {count, plural, one {# request waiting} other {# requests waiting}}
queue.backToQueue: {count, plural, one {Back to the one waiting} other {Back to the # waiting}}

detail.lapsed: The deadline passed, so this can no longer be decided here. GOTCHA has handed the conversation to a person.
detail.outcomeUnknown: This was approved before GOTCHA recorded what happened next, so we can't tell you whether it ran. It can't be retried — re-running it could repeat something that already happened.

announce.approvedButFailed: Approved: {summary}. It did not run — you can try again.

error.stale: Someone else decided this, or its deadline passed. Reloading to show where it stands.
error.reason_required: Say why before rejecting — GOTCHA uses the reason to stop asking wrongly.

rest.lead: Nothing needs a decision from you.
rest.body: Everything that came up was inside the limits you set. GOTCHA handled it and kept going.
rest.title: Nothing waiting on you

decided.heading: What you decided earlier
decided.unavailable: We couldn't read your past decisions just now.
decided.lapsed: Deadline passed at {when} — handed to a person
decided.didNotRun: You approved this, but it didn't run. Open it to try again.
decided.outcomeUnknown: Approved before GOTCHA recorded what happened next, so we can't say whether it ran.
decided.incomplete: This shows your most recent decisions, not all of them — GOTCHA can only hand back the last hundred of each kind.
decided.lapsedNoTime: Deadline passed — handed to a person
decided.incompleteShort: Your most recent decisions — the list holds the last hundred of each kind.

moment.factExecutionFailed: GOTCHA could not carry it out.
moment.factCustomerNotYet: The customer hasn't been told yet.
moment.noUndo: There's no undo for this yet.

pattern.title: That's the {count, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} like it
pattern.body: {approved} approved like this here, {rejected, plural, =0 {none} other {#}} rejected.

failure.connection: The store connection needs reconnecting — {provider} refused GOTCHA's access.
failure.already_done: It had already been done, so nothing changed.
failure.after_shipping: It can't be done once the order has shipped.
failure.not_permitted: A permission or a rule stopped it.
failure.provider_unavailable: {provider} didn't answer. This usually passes — try again.
failure.exceeds_limit: It's over a limit — the amount or count is too high.
failure.unknown: {provider} didn't say why in words we can show.

pending.title: {count, plural, one {One thing needs your decision} other {# things need your decision}}
pending.soonest: GOTCHA has done the work. The next deadline is in {in}.

card.leaveBody: If nobody decides by {when}, it lapses and the conversation goes to a person.

action2.next: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing after this} one {One more after this · ↓ for the next} other {# more after this · ↓ for the next}}
